name: Jetpack (Superior)
description: Jetpacks are personal aerial transportation devices that allow the operator to fly into and through the air with great mobility. Activating or deactivating the jetpack requires a bonus action and, while active, you have a flying speed of 60 feet. The jetpack last for 1 minute per power cell (to a maximum of 16 minutes) and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the power cells.
